propositions: A replayable corpus of ~4,300 plan_review_result_v2 sidecars with reconstructed plan text and material-fingerprint equivalence is needed to instrument plan-review gate changes against historical outcomes without live A/B testing.

Three tiered evaluation runs (Pass-3 deterministic replay, Pass-2 re-verify on stored findings, Pass-1 re-find on samples) must operate under a hard $200 Bedrock budget with committed ledger tracking and model-parity enforcement across all LLM calls.

Pass-3 changes (formula, threshold, routing) must be assessable over the entire corpus with zero LLM cost by replaying decision logic against stored Pass-1 findings and outcome labels derived from revision pairs and verdict flips.

Pass-2 changes (questions, prompt) must be evaluated on stratified samples using stored Pass-1 findings, with per-question agreement vs stored answers measured against a noise floor established by identical-material verdict flips.

Tier-2 Pass-1 finding-set changes must be comparable by norm_id and criterion against stored findings, with single-criterion mode support for isolated edits and downstream impact visible through Tier-1/Tier-0 propagation.

Every eval must record per-pass model id, refuse to diff differing model ids, require Bedrock Anthropic models (Opus/Sonnet) as configured, activate prompt caching, and refuse runs exceeding remaining budget allocation.
